verdict.rationale: Formant's own materials describe an in-product AI assistant in Analytics for building dashboards from device data (formant-docs-7, formant-docs-25). They also describe asking the fleet "what's happening" in plain language and receiving governed, ML-driven task recommendations (formant-docs-12, formant-docs-23). Together these cover both AI-generated insights and suggestions inside the product, but the evidence is one-line claims with no depth. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what the AI assistant can analyze or explain, details on how recommendations are generated and surfaced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
